paths.title: Academy Master
paths.description: Master the fundamentals of arcane magic until even your simplest spells set up stronger follow-up attacks and strike with greater force. Your schooling sharpens your Arcana knowledge, while an action point gives you a chance to correct a missed attack. You can pour extra power into familiar spells, reclaim an encounter attack that misses every target, and eventually turn a practiced encounter spell into a more punishing assault with longer-lasting effects.

paths.title: Arcane Wellspring
paths.description: Let two sources of raw power flow through you at once, doubling the resistances granted by your Dragon Soul or Wild Soul. Your arcane powers ignore enemy resistance to both types, up to your own, and an action point splits a single-target spell onto another creature. Your signature attacks deal both damage types, whether as a twin bolt, a pair of wings that punish opportunity attacks, or a daily metamorphosis that leaves you insubstantial. Later, your area and close attacks can swap two creatures' positions.

paths.title: Blizzard Mage
paths.description: Bring winter down on the battlefield, slowing and freezing enemies until they can barely stand against the wind. Spending an action point on an attack slows every creature it hits or misses, and you can keep moving while immobilized or slowed. Winter's Clutch freezes a target in place and slides your allies, Cloak of Freezing Wind throws attackers away from you, and your daily Blizzard knocks enemies prone and keeps buffeting everything nearby. Your critical hits can shove any creature in range.

paths.title: Celestial Scholar
paths.description: Study the sun, moon, and stars until your Soul of the Cosmic Cycle answers with greater command. Action points boost your cold, psychic, and radiant powers, and a daily power lets you leap to either other phase. Choose one phase to strengthen with a scorching aura, a teleporting dodge, or radiance against foes beside you. Celestial Sigil and Celestial Seal carry phase effects into your attacks, and standing in your focused phase eventually improves every defense.

paths.title: Demonskin Adept
paths.description: Wrap yourself in the fury of the Abyss and spread the frenzy around you. Spending an action point sharpens the attacks of you and your allies, but your enemies strike you more accurately as well. You can change the damage type your soul resists once per encounter, deal extra damage while bloodied, and blind both yourself and your target with a critical hit. Demon-Soul Bolts batter foes in repeated thunder volleys, and Swords of the Marilith fills the air with whirling blades that cut enemies or shield your allies.

paths.title: Dragon Guardian
paths.description: Stand as a draconic bulwark, breathing out power that draws enemy attention and punishes those who ignore you. Close blast attacks made with an action point score critical hits more often, and you add a second resistance to the one your Dragon Soul provides. Guardian's Breath marks enemies and leaves them vulnerable, a shield of dragon might extends your protection, and Lasting Breath afflicts foes with ongoing damage. Eventually your close blasts ignore resistance and immunity.

paths.title: Essence Mage
paths.description: Treat magic as a substance and pour it into every spell. Arcane powers that deal more than one type of damage deal extra damage, action points make your arcane attacks more accurate, and any resistance you gain grows stronger. You hurl rippling energy of two chosen types while gaining combat advantage, turn insubstantial to recover temporary hit points, and launch a daily force burst after which you resist all damage and sting adjacent enemies whenever you cast.

paths.title: Luckbender
paths.description: Cheat fate for fun and profit. When you roll initiative you can reroll your Wild Soul resistance, and an action point attack lets you bet on the roll, regaining your lowest-level encounter attack power if the die lands where you called it. You answer an enemy's miss with a convenient backlash, Even the Odds adds or subtracts a die from anyone's roll, and Lucky Number makes critical hits far more common with your sorcerer and luckbender powers.

paths.title: Master of Flame
paths.description: Give yourself completely to fire, spreading burning wounds and eventually widening every arcane fire burst and blast you cast. Critical hits kindle lingering flames, and an action point scorches enemies gathered beside you. You can fan an existing blaze into a second explosion, become an insubstantial creature of fire whose touch punishes melee attackers, and raise a hungry inferno that drags nearby creatures toward its center.

paths.title: Master Preserver
paths.description: Draw on the vital energy around you without harming it, and let that restraint make you tougher, healthier and a better steward of your allies. The land sharpens your Endurance, Nature and Perception, and an action point lets you reroll an attack or damage roll and keep the better result. At higher levels every healing surge you spend heals a nearby ally and sharpens your aim. Your spells turn an enemy's vitality into healing, shield a friend from a blow, and bathe the battlefield in a zone of weakening, restorative light.

paths.title: Primordial Channeler
paths.description: Channel the Elemental Chaos through your Wild Soul and let its current element shape every strike. When your resistance is cold, fire, lightning, or thunder, your hits gain a matching rider such as slowing, ongoing fire damage, an attack penalty, or deafening. Action points damage nearby enemies with the same element, while a daily boon grants broad resistance and a daily rift stuns foes and adds a second Wild Soul benefit. Overwhelming Elements strips resistance from those you hit.

paths.title: Speaker of Xaos
paths.description: Master the forces of elemental chaos as a scholar of its ways. Action points widen your next cold, fire, lightning, or thunder attack, adding a target or enlarging its area, and you strike elemental creatures more accurately while they struggle against your effects. Elemental Durance pushes an enemy into a prison of energy, Repel Elements wards off elemental foes, and Elemental Chains restrains enemies with ongoing damage. Eventually your elemental damage dice never roll low.

paths.title: Wild Mage
paths.description: Embrace unpredictability and let wild magic make your fights anything but safe. Action points roll for a random bonus such as invisibility, teleportation, or temporary hit points, and a natural 1 on an arcane attack can become a gamble that might turn the miss into a hit. Tempest Surge sweeps a chaotic burst of shifting size, Torrent of Power lets your highest damage dice explode, and Prismatic Bolt delivers a colorful effect rolled at random. Your critical hits eventually add extra damage.
